name: Virtual instrument plug-in
definition: Plug-in that makes sound when played from a host program: a synthesizer, sampler or drum machine.
notes: Plugin Boutique sells Instruments (Synth, Sampler, Drum Machine) as its own top-level category apart from Effects

name: Audio effect plug-in
definition: Plug-in that processes sound passing through a host program: reverb, delay, EQ, compressor or similar.
notes: Plugin Boutique sells Effects (Reverb, EQ, Compressor, Delay) as its own top-level category apart from Instruments
